scope: 42 equipment entries and 58 other item models; no blocks, player or Boss

displayPolicy.XY: Keep existing per-item length, width, grip and rotation
displayPolicy.Z: Use diamond sword local Z display scale for matching context, independent of per-item XY scale
displayPolicy.order: T * R * scale(sx,sy,referenceSz); thickness evaluated in item-local space
displayPolicy.zeroThicknessShield: Use supplied solid double-material front model, not the current z=0 face renderer
displayPolicy.fallback: Legacy and provider drawing paths need same per-context local-Z rule

entries.providerPolicy: Keep complete provider and layers; normalize local Z around model center before display. Do not scale world Z after rotation.
